hyperedges.label: Self-improving work-memory loop (save-result → reflect → LESSONS.md → skill)
C++-family extractor reuse (CUDA, Metal) with cross-language edge filtering
Node identity, stub rewiring and ghost-duplicate prevention

nodes.label: --missing-only relabel flag
nodes.rationale: Lets a large graph be relabeled incrementally without re-naming (and paying for) communities that already have good names.

nodes.label: Metal (.metal) shader indexing
nodes.rationale: Metal Shading Language is C++14, so .metal is classified as code and routed through the existing C++ extractor, mirroring the CUDA .cu/.cuh reuse — no new grammar dependency.

nodes.label: CUDA (.cu/.cuh) extraction
nodes.rationale: CUDA is a C++ superset, so these files route through the existing tree-sitter-cpp extractor — no new grammar dependency.

nodes.label: Cross-language edge-filter family map
nodes.rationale: Suppresses phantom cross-language calls edges between related-family extensions and C++.

nodes.label: OpenAI-compatible chat-completion backends
nodes.rationale: stream: False is now passed explicitly because some gateways default to SSE streaming when stream is omitted, but graphify always reads the result as a single response.

nodes.label: Java extractor
nodes.rationale: Field types and class-level annotations were missing from the graph even though parameter/return types and method annotations were already captured; primitives are still skipped.

nodes.label: Objective-C extractor
nodes.rationale: A .h is routed to the ObjC extractor only when it contains an ObjC-only directive, which never hijacks a real C/C++ header; selector parts are read from the grammar's `method` fields, skipping the receiver, so compound sends resolve.

nodes.label: WPF/XAML extractor
nodes.rationale: Uses stdlib XML with the same DOCTYPE/ENTITY and size guards as the .csproj extractor so no new parser dependency is needed; event resolution is gated on the .NET handler signature so a property value matching a method name can't fabricate a spurious event edge.

nodes.label: XAML view-to-ViewModel linking
nodes.rationale: Resolution is always checked against an actually-extracted C# class, so a name with no matching class (or an ambiguous one) emits no edge; explicit DataContext is EXTRACTED, naming conventions are INFERRED.

nodes.label: extract_vue
nodes.rationale: Masks everything outside <script> by replacing it with spaces so line numbers stay accurate, then parses just the script with the grammar named by `lang`.

nodes.label: graphify reflect
nodes.rationale: Deterministic, no LLM: scans the memory dir and writes LESSONS.md so an agent can load prior outcomes at the start of the next session.

nodes.label: reflect --if-stale
nodes.rationale: Skips the run when LESSONS.md is already newer than every input, so the agent's session-start run costs almost nothing when the hook just refreshed it; a missing sidecar is treated as not-an-input so no-cluster builds are unaffected.

nodes.label: Work-memory loop
nodes.rationale: The skill now tells the agent to run reflect --if-stale itself so a skill-only install still regenerates LESSONS.md; the post-commit hook becomes an optimization for between-session freshness rather than a requirement.

nodes.label: graphify save-result
nodes.rationale: Outcome is written to both the memory doc frontmatter and an ## Outcome body section so the signal stays machine-readable and round-trips into the graph on the next semantic re-extraction.

nodes.label: Time-decayed source-node outcome scoring
nodes.rationale: Citations are scored, not counted — each is a signed, time-decayed value so a fresh dead end outweighs a months-old useful; a node is promoted to preferred only after corroboration by >=2 distinct results so one save can't mint a trusted lesson.

nodes.label: post-commit / post-checkout git hooks
nodes.rationale: Auto-run reflect after each rebuild, best-effort and only when saved outcomes exist, so LESSONS.md stays current without a manual graphify reflect.

nodes.label: Read|Glob PreToolUse hook
nodes.rationale: The old any(ext in path) substring check both false-fired on .json (because .js is a substring) and never fired on .astro/.vue/.svelte; matching the real trailing extension fixes both directions while keeping graphify-out/ suppression and fail-open behavior.

nodes.label: "graphify needs no API key" skill guidance
nodes.rationale: Terminal-style hosts run the CLI directly and don't dispatch subagents, so framing the no-key path only as "fall through to subagent dispatch" made them loop insisting on an API key; the statement is hoisted to the top of Step 3 with a non-subagent fallback.

nodes.label: Aider/Devin monolith skills
nodes.rationale: Hand-maintained single-file skills frozen against a pinned pristine-v8 blob by a round-trip guard, so they had been excluded from runbook fixes.

nodes.label: Monolith round-trip drift guard
nodes.rationale: Changed from a positional zip that forbade any line-count change to a multiset diff classifying each added/removed line against sanctioned change-classes, so multi-line fixes can land while unsanctioned drift still fails.

nodes.label: to_canvas (Obsidian Canvas export)
nodes.rationale: The box width assumed a roughly-square sqrt(n)-column layout while placement hardcoded 3 columns; the column count is now computed once per community and reused for box width, box height, and card placement.

nodes.label: to_wiki (Wikipedia-style export)
nodes.rationale: Emits portable relative markdown links instead of Obsidian [[wikilinks]] so navigation works in every renderer, not just Obsidian; links whose target has no article are downgraded to plain text instead of left dangling.

nodes.label: Case-folded filename dedup helper
nodes.rationale: Dedup keyed on exact case let labels differing only by case clobber each other on case-insensitive filesystems (macOS/APFS, Windows/NTFS); folding case while emitting the original-case filename makes any on-disk collision get a numeric suffix. Shared in one helper so obsidian and canvas can't drift.

nodes.label: KIMI/GEMINI/DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL overrides
nodes.rationale: Each falls back to its hardcoded official default when the variable is unset, so behavior is unchanged for everyone who doesn't set it.

nodes.label: get_community MCP tool
nodes.rationale: The name is read from member nodes, sanitised like every other LLM-derived field, and skipped when it is just the Community N placeholder so the header never doubles.

nodes.label: starlette >=1.3.1 floor (CVE-2026-48818, CVE-2026-54283)
nodes.rationale: It was an undeclared transitive dependency (via mcp) that graphify/serve.py imports directly, so declaring and flooring it protects end users installing graphifyy[mcp], not just the locked dev/CI environment.

nodes.label: extract.py monolith
nodes.rationale: Re-exports the moved names so every `from graphify.extract import ...` caller and the dispatch table are unchanged.

nodes.label: graphify/extractors/ per-language modules
nodes.rationale: Strict one-way import direction (extract.py -> extractors/, never the reverse); behavior-neutral lift-and-shift verified byte-identical as groundwork for moving the remaining languages out.

nodes.label: Parallel community labeling (--max-concurrency)
nodes.rationale: Output is unchanged and deterministic regardless of concurrency because results are keyed by community id and merged on the main thread; ollama and claude-cli are forced serial as a safety guard.

nodes.label: File-aware anti-shrink guard
nodes.rationale: A net shrink is allowed when every lost node belongs to a file re-extracted this run (or deleted), and still refused when a node disappears from an untouched file — the failed/partial-extraction case the guard exists to catch.

nodes.label: validate_extraction
nodes.rationale: Reports a bad id/endpoint as an error string (its documented contract) rather than raising, so one malformed LLM node can't abort the build of an otherwise-complete corpus.

nodes.label: build_from_json
nodes.rationale: Skips malformed entries with a stderr warning while keeping every well-formed node/edge; non-dict nodes are still left to raise so shape diagnostics are unchanged. Hyperedge source_file relativization lives here (not to_json, which has no root to relativize against).

nodes.label: build_merge
nodes.rationale: Reconciles changed files by replace-on-re-extract, so the update runbook prunes only genuinely deleted files.

nodes.label: _resolve_python_member_calls
nodes.rationale: Emits the edge only when the receiver resolves to exactly one class that owns the method (single-definition god-node guard); instance/module calls with lowercase receivers are unaffected. Mirrors the Swift receiver-based pass.

nodes.label: Swift receiver-type member-call resolver
nodes.rationale: Edges are emitted only when the receiver's type resolves to exactly one definition (preserving the god-node guards) and are tagged INFERRED; the blanket member-call skip in the shared call pass is untouched.

nodes.label: God-node collision guard
nodes.rationale: The shared cross-file pass skips all member calls to avoid bare obj.method() collisions fabricating a god node.

nodes.label: agents / skills install platform
nodes.rationale: Writes the spec's user-global ~/.agents/skills location that npx skills and spec-compliant frameworks read; previously that path was only reachable as an accidental side effect of the gemini-on-Windows branch. Bare graphify install stays single-platform.

nodes.label: Trigram candidate prefilter for query
nodes.rationale: The prefilter is a strict superset of the exhaustive scorer, so results and ranking are unchanged; short/CJK queries and low-selectivity terms fall back to the full scan.

nodes.label: diagnose_extraction graph-health gate
nodes.rationale: Read-only — surfaces dangling/self-loop/collapsed-edge warnings before labeling but never aborts the build.

nodes.label: _platform_skill_destination
nodes.rationale: Hermes scans %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes\skills on Windows, so the POSIX ~/.hermes/skills default left the skill undiscovered there.

nodes.label: ensure_named_node stub minting
nodes.rationale: Now emits a sourceless stub (like the inheritance-base path) so cross-file type-annotation references resolve to the single canonical definition instead of colliding into per-file phantom ids.

nodes.label: _rewire_unique_stub_nodes
nodes.rationale: Could previously only repair the globally-unique case, so same-named Java types across packages left the real definition isolated.

nodes.label: opencode plugin search reminder
nodes.rationale: The reminder is now plain text because bash performed command substitution on backticks inside the double-quoted echo, silently running graphify query on every search.

nodes.label: llm._EXTRACTION_SYSTEM native prompt
nodes.rationale: It only ever showed "hyperedges":[] and never explained what a hyperedge is, so native backends silently emitted zero while the agent path produced them; the two prompts had drifted and are now guard-tested against drifting apart again.

nodes.label: GRAPHIFY_OUT output-dir override
nodes.rationale: Supports worktrees and shared setups; default behaviour is unchanged without the env var. The detect scan-exclude honours it so a renamed output dir is never re-ingested as source.

nodes.label: graphify.paths module
nodes.rationale: Consolidates the graphify-out name that was duplicated across __main__, cache, and watch into a single source of truth.

nodes.label: save_manifest
nodes.rationale: Runbooks now pass root= so manifest keys are relativized to the scan root; absolute keys broke graphify --update after cloning or moving the repo, forcing a full re-extract.

nodes.label: Semantic extraction cache (.graphify_cached.json)
nodes.rationale: Deleted on a cache miss so Part C never merges a stale cache from a prior run. Deliberately unversioned because LLM calls are expensive to re-run.

nodes.label: AST cache (versioned)
nodes.rationale: Namespaced by graphify version under cache/ast/<version>/ so stale entries from a previous release can't silently produce wrong extraction output after an upgrade.

nodes.label: Step 4 zero-node guard
nodes.rationale: Now runs before any write, with report/analysis gated on to_json actually persisting the graph, because it previously ran after GRAPH_REPORT.md/graph.json/analysis were already written.

nodes.label: --directed propagation (IS_DIRECTED)
nodes.rationale: Without propagating directed= into build_from_json/build_merge, a --directed run silently rebuilt undirected and collapsed reciprocal A<->B edges.

nodes.label: Semantic extraction scoped to document/paper/image
nodes.rationale: Code is already covered structurally by the AST pass, so scoping semantic extraction stops subagents from re-reading every source file.

nodes.label: FileSlice oversized-text slicing
nodes.rationale: Oversized splittable-text files are sliced at heading/paragraph boundaries; every slice reports its parent file as source_file so the graph is not fragmented per-slice. Code files and PDFs are never sliced because they keep whole-symbol / page handling.

nodes.label: extract_corpus_parallel / extract_files_direct
nodes.rationale: Items are coerced to Path only when not already a Path or FileSlice, because blanket coercion raised TypeError on sliced documents.

nodes.label: Package-manifest dependency extractor
nodes.rationale: Each manifest yields ONE canonical package node keyed by name, routed to the AST path so the LLM never sees it — otherwise the same package got a different file-anchored id from its own manifest than from each dependent's reference and split into duplicates.

nodes.label: extract_markdown
nodes.rationale: Link targets are resolved via the same node-id recipe so they merge onto the real doc node; external URLs, in-page anchors, and images are skipped.

nodes.label: graphify.ids node-ID normalization module
nodes.rationale: Four hand-synced copies of the same NFKC/casefold recipe were the root of the recurring ghost-node bug class, so all delegate to one implementation guarded by contract + hypothesis property tests.

nodes.label: AST/semantic ghost-node merge
nodes.rationale: Detects the AST/semantic pair by (source_file basename, label) and collapses the semantic ghost into the AST node, re-pointing all edges; ambiguous keys where multiple AST nodes share the pair are skipped because last-writer-wins mis-pointed edges to an arbitrary canonical node.

nodes.label: .graphifyignore / .gitignore merge
nodes.rationale: Merged per directory rather than replaced: .gitignore is read first and .graphifyignore last so its patterns still win on conflict, and adding one can only ever exclude more — previously a neutrally-named secret excluded only by .gitignore got indexed into artifacts that are routinely committed.

nodes.label: collect_files walker
nodes.rationale: Rewritten as a single pruned os.walk instead of one rglob per extension, pruning noise directories before descent; negation rules no longer disable pruning because gitignore semantics cannot rescue files beneath an excluded parent.

nodes.label: Fuzzy dedup (dedup.py)
nodes.rationale: Code nodes are deduplicated by ID only because distinct same-named symbols in different files are genuinely different; cross-file labels use plain Jaro so the Jaro-Winkler leading-prefix bonus can't fabricate a merge, and a strict-prefix guard blocks prefix-extension pairs.

nodes.label: Pure-numpy MinHash/MinHashLSH
nodes.rationale: Replaces datasketch, which transitively imported scipy -> numpy.testing -> a platform.machine() subprocess at import time and hung EDR/corporate Windows; the byte-identical hash math removes datasketch and scipy from the dependency tree.

nodes.label: SSRF guard (per-connection HTTP(S) subclasses)
nodes.rationale: Per-connection subclasses resolve DNS once, validate the IP, and connect to that exact address, closing both the concurrent-thread race and the TOCTOU gap; no global state is mutated so sibling threads are unaffected.

nodes.label: Untrusted-source prompt-injection mitigation
nodes.rationale: Source content is wrapped in XML delimiters with a sha256, jailbreak sentinel tokens are neutralised with a zero-width space, and the system prompt states the wrapped content is inert data.

nodes.label: JSON config/manifest extractor
nodes.rationale: Only config/manifest JSON (by filename or top-level keys) is processed; data JSON is skipped by the AST pass and left for the LLM so it no longer explodes into hundreds of orphan key-nodes.

nodes.label: _is_sensitive filename heuristic
nodes.rationale: Generic keywords only fire when the keyword ends the filename stem or the stem is <=2 words, so topic-mentioning filenames aren't silently dropped; specific patterns like .env and id_rsa remain unconditional.

nodes.label: claude-cli backend
nodes.rationale: Resolves claude.cmd first on win32 because npm-installed Claude Code ships a .cmd shim that CreateProcess cannot run without the explicit extension; the envelope parser accepts both the legacy single object and CLI >=2.1's streaming array, preferring the last result event.

nodes.label: JS/TS symbol & import resolution
nodes.rationale: Constructor-assigned, CommonJS, prototype, and class-field callables are captured, but arbitrary obj.x = fn is deliberately not, preserving the phantom-god-node guard; default imports are recorded as imported_name="default" so default-exported classes get incoming symbol edges.

nodes.label: tsconfig paths alias resolution
nodes.rationale: Aliases are resolved relative to baseUrl rather than the config file's directory, which had broken layouts that set baseUrl to ./src.

nodes.label: community_name node attribute
nodes.rationale: Read paths fall back to the numeric community field for backward compatibility with old graphs.

nodes.label: label_communities
nodes.rationale: A malformed-JSON batch is split at the midpoint and each half retried (mirroring the extract path) instead of logged-and-skipped, which silently lost ~100 community names per failed batch.

nodes.label: FalkorDB export backend
nodes.rationale: FalkorDB is OpenCypher-compatible, so the MERGE/SET upsert queries match the Neo4j path; optional dep with lazy import and Cypher injection guarded.

nodes.label: graphify affected
nodes.rationale: Forces a directed graph on load because on undirected graphs the traversal was direction-blind, missing true callers and reporting callees as affected.

nodes.label: Live PostgreSQL introspection
nodes.rationale: Maps tables, views, routines, and FK relations via information_schema in a SERIALIZABLE READ ONLY transaction; credentials are sanitized from error messages.

nodes.label: Salesforce Apex extractor
nodes.rationale: Extracted via regex because no tree-sitter grammar exists for Apex.

nodes.label: Streamable HTTP MCP transport
nodes.rationale: Lets a single shared process serve the whole team; stdio remains the default.

nodes.label: Vision & PDF headless extract
nodes.rationale: Images route through per-backend vision payloads instead of producing garbage binary data; non-vision backends get a text reference via _strip_pixels.

nodes.label: _origin="ast" node stamp
nodes.rationale: On a full rebuild any stamped node absent from the fresh output is dropped, so deleting a function no longer leaves a ghost node until the file itself is deleted.

nodes.label: Windows 61-worker clamp
nodes.rationale: ProcessPoolExecutor on Windows is hard-capped at 61 workers via WaitForMultipleObjects, so the clamp applies to all three input paths.

nodes.label: GRAPHIFY_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS / output-token cap
nodes.rationale: The dispatch read only max_completion_tokens (a gemini-only key), so other backends' advertised 16384 cap was dead and deep-mode JSON truncated mid-string; it now reads either key.

nodes.label: calls edge direction rule in prompt
nodes.rationale: The prompt never stated that source = caller and target = callee, so the LLM systematically emitted callee->caller edges; an explicit direction rule raised calls precision to 100% on the annotated sample.

nodes.label: Unified query reference (vocab/IDF expansion + NetworkX fallback)
nodes.rationale: The two capabilities were split across cli.md/cli-inline.md so no platform got both; merging them into one reference ships expansion and the CLI-down fallback to every host and removes the query_variant enum.
